summary: Completed testing of targeted messaging feature for La Bague Impériale. All features working correctly: API POST /api/messages with targeted recipients, frontend modal with 'Tous les membres' checkbox and individual member selection.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Used existing 35 members for testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Targeted messaging feature complete. All features tested and working correctly.

POST /api/messages with empty destinatai.details: When destinataires=[], all 35 members receive notifications

POST /api/messages with specific IDs.details: When destinataires=[id1, id2], only 2 notifications created

Message storage with destinataires.details: Message stored with correct destinataires list

All message types.details: rappel_cotisation, rappel_sondage, nouvel_evenement, nouveau_membre, sortie_club, message_libre all work

GET /api/members.details: Returns 35 members with id and nom_complet fields

Messages page access.details: Accessible via sidebar when logged in as Président

Message templates display.details: 6 templates shown: Rappel de cotisation, Rappel de sondage, Nouvel événement, Annonce nouveau membre, Annonce sortie du club, Message libre

Modal opens on template click.details: Clicking 'Message libre' opens modal with title, content, and destinataires sections

Destinataires section.details: Shows 'Tous les membres (35)' checkbox, checked by default

Uncheck 'Tous les membres'.details: Unchecking reveals scrollable list of 35 individual member checkboxes

Individual member selection.details: Can select specific members (e.g., Fabien Lanfranchi, Jacques Peretti)

Send targeted message.details: Clicking 'Envoyer' sends message to selected members only, shows success toast

Modal closes after send.details: Modal closes and returns to Messages page after successful send
